findings.evidence: Lines 261–266 establish continuation via the single-valued principal branch on `Complex.slitPlane`, while lines 306–320 only negate existence of an analytic function on `{0}ᶜ`.

summary: The slit-plane theorem is vacuously overgeneralized, and the module’s headline misstates the proved global obstruction.
